title: Science, not public worries, behind Lapu-Lapu City class suspensions
summary: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu— School suspensions in Lapu-Lapu City will soon rely on scientific indicators—including real-time air quality tracking—rather than public apprehension, local officials announced…

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu— School suspensions in Lapu-Lapu City will soon rely on scientific indicators—including real-time air quality tracking—rather than public apprehension, local officials announced following a consultation with private school administrators. In a joint dialogue organized by the Lapu-Lapu City Government and the Department of Education (DepEd) Lapu-Lapu City Division, City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) Head Dr. Nagiel Bañacia stressed the need for measurable early warning signs when deciding to halt classes during emergencies or public health hazards.
